title: GraphersalGraphSchema
description: A Graphersal graph schema: an envelope (mode, meta, labels, connections) around a strict subset of JSON Schema 2020-12 for each label's properties. Unknown keys are errors everywhere.

meta.description: Free-form data the library stores, round-trips and never interprets.

label_schema.description: The JSON Schema of a label's property map: an object node, optionally with $defs for local $ref.

node.description: One property schema node. integer = int64, number = float64, string + format uuid = uuid, string + format date-time / date / local-date-time / time / duration = datetime / date / localdatetime / time / duration (time and local-date-time have no UTC offset). formatMinimum, formatMaximum, formatExclusiveMinimum and formatExclusiveMaximum (text of the format's type) need one of these temporal formats. array + format vector = a vector (an embedding) with element (f32, f16, i8, bit; default f32), dimension (optional) and metric (an annotation) and, on a top-level property, embedder (the model identity of the embedder that produced the vectors) and from (the vector rule: the source property the engine embeds); items is not allowed next to it.

element.description: With format vector: the element kind of the stored vectors (default f32).

dimension.description: With format vector: the number of components.

metric.description: With format vector: an annotation, the metric the vectors are compared with.

embedder.description: With format vector, on a label's top-level property only: the model identity of the embedder that produced the vectors (hash-ngram/1). a vector rule (from) embeds with that model; a text query of nearest() or similarity() embeds its text with the registered embedder of that model.

from.description: With format vector and embedder, on a label's top-level property only: the vector rule. The name of the top-level property of the same label whose text the engine embeds into this property at the end of every unit that writes it; a text-less source removes the vector.

default.description: On a label's top-level property, in mode open or closed: stored when a vertex or edge is created without the property (null is never stored); never applied on read or to existing data. Elsewhere an annotation.

defaultFunction.description: On a label's top-level property only: a value computed for every vertex or edge created without the property, in mode open or closed (now and today: the unit's start, one value per unit). Not together with default.
